newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Great Northern, American Gem may merge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Great Northern, American Gem may merge.

text.p: Sapphire miner Great Northern Mining Corp NL said on Wednesday it has entered into merger talks with Canada's American Gem Corp.
American Gem operates sapphire mines in Montana and controls proprietary heat treatment technology which has the ability to enhance the colour of sapphire.

Great Northern said American Gem controlled 62.9 million carats of sapphire resources and when combined with Great Northern's deposits of sapphire resource in Australia, the merged company would be the world's largest sapphire producer.

The company said completion of a merger was subject to successfully concluded merger negotiations and the establishment of a definitive merger agreement as well as shareholder and other approvals as required.
Great Northern shares closed untraded but bid at 14 cents, down one cent from its previous close on September 5.
At 14 cents the company is valued at just under A$6 million.
American Gem shares last traded at C$1.90.
